NOT IN DOCUMENTS. The meaning of error ERR-PO-0412 and its resolution steps are not covered in the available documentation for Bahi ERP 7.2. Please check with your ERP administrator or the IT helpdesk for assistance with this error code.

Error ERR-PO-0412 means that the selected tax code does not match the supplier's state region [MAN-PUR-72 §17.2]. This occurs because Fetch defaults to an -INTRA code (CGST + SGST) for the plant's own state, whereas a supplier in another state requires an -INTER code (IGST) [MAN-PUR-72 §11.4, §17.2]. To fix it, change the tax code to the matching -INTER code with the same rate (such as GST18-INTER) and save the order again [MAN-PUR-72 §17.2].

Error ERR-PO-0412 means that the tax code entered is for the wrong region based on the supplier's state [MAN-PUR-72 §17.2]. A supplier in the plant's own state requires an -INTRA code (CGST + SGST), while a supplier in any other state requires an -INTER code (IGST) [MAN-PUR-72 §17.2]. To fix this error, change the tax code to the -INTER code with the same rate (such as GST18-INTER) and save again [MAN-PUR-72 §17.2].

Error `ERR-PO-0412 TAX REGION DOES NOT MATCH SUPPLIER STATE` means that the selected tax code region does not match the supplier's state, which occurs because Fetch defaults to `GST18-INTRA` when a supplier is outside the plant's state [MAN-PUR-72 §17.2]. You can resolve it by changing the tax code to an `-INTER` code with the same rate (for example, `GST18-INTER`) [MAN-PUR-72 §17.2].
